parsed.rationale: All four duplicate `data` methods reside in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and are nested inside per-test-class `SequentialMockSession` helper types (`iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `LastFMArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`, `DiscogsArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession`). Although the context flags do not carry `is_test: true`, the file path (`Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift`) and the naming convention (`…Tests.SequentialMockSession`) make clear these are test-internal mock session helpers, each scoped to its own test class to avoid cross-test coupling. The structural duplication is intentional: each `SequentialMockSession` is a lightweight, self-contained stub whose identical shape is coincidental to the test fixture pattern rather than a sign of shared logic that should be extracted. Consolidating them into a single shared helper would couple unrelated test classes and complicate future per-service divergence.
